messages:
violet: quick sync  i opened a compact migration guide PR for the v1->v2 sunset focused on snippets and example fallout: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2255

asher: link received. two tiny asks: (1) include the exact error string for support to grep, (2) a minimal embed-dim fallback pattern.

nina: for (1) what's the canonical error text? we should show it across JS/Python/Go so engineers can search logs.

violet: planned error text: "Error: 410 DeprecatedEndpoint: this endpoint has been removed, please upgrade to client v2". i'll add 1-line examples in each language.

asher: for the embed fallback, prefer a deterministic pad helper rather than full example app. keep it one function per language.

chris: small ops note: prefer path-level 301 redirects for CDN caching. canary plan: 48h @5% then 24h @50% before full flip. include a rollback flag in the redirect map.

nina: i'll draft a Python pad helper and a JS one-liner. add a short caveat: "re-normalize after padding" so downstream cosine scores remain comparable.

violet: adding examples now. tiny snippets i'll include:

```
# python
def pad(vec, target=1536):
    return vec[:target] if len(vec) >= target else vec + [0.0] * (target - len(vec))

// js
function pad(vec, target=1536) { return vec.length >= target ? vec.slice(0, target) : vec.concat(Array(target - vec.length).fill(0.0)); }
```

chris: legal wants 21 days soft notice. ops wants 14 preferred; i'll reconcile on the rollout calendar. also surface a note for Dedicated/Private customers: we won't run redirects for private installs without AE coordination.

asher: i'll add a short Ruby and Go grep-friendly example showing the exception/message shape.

docs-bot: Reminder: tag the PR with `deprecation`, `migration`, `needs-smoke`. CI will run snippet lint and the examples smoke tests on push. :robot_face:

violet: thanks all  i'll push the updated PR with (a) language error strings, (b) pad helpers, (c) rollback checklist, and (d) rollout calendar by EOD. ping here when ready for review. :thumbsup:
